model.sports: sports.json lists every sport. Each sport has data/{sport}/manifest.json pointing at any number of Season_*.csn files.
model.sectors: sectors.json lists every operating sector. Each sector has data/sectors/{id}/manifest.json and optional clubs.json plus sport-scoped CSN files.
model.seasons: seasons.json is an optional index. New seasons are also discovered from filenames and CSN meta.s. There is no season or sector cap.
